listing.name: Halo 3 — halo-3-recomp (george0815)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the main menu, campaign and multiplayer loading, and HUD output. Washed-out in-game frames and a debug movie shortcut remain. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Halo 3 Xbox 360 disc and default.xex. The required revision is not confirmed here; check upstream before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source-build instructions with CMake, Ninja and Clang 18 to generate H3RecompLib and the patched FFmpeg/XMA runtime. Portcove does not install or build this project automatically.
